summary: Iter 12 Advanced Combo Slots — tested backend slot semantics + POST/GET/PATCH persistence, and frontend ComboEditor UI (slot builder, product toggles, save). 5/5 backend tests pass. UI flow (open editor → set name/discount → add 2nd slot → switch to AND → pick products → save → combo appears in list) works end-to-end.

ui_bugs.issue: Slot-based combos display an empty 'WHEN TICKET CONTAINS:' row on the combo card (only legacy flat product_ids are rendered as chips). Users can't see slot rules at a glance from the list — must open the editor to view them.
ui_bugs.selector: combo card body under text 'WHEN TICKET CONTAINS'

action_items: Enhance Menu combos card view to render slot rules (e.g. 'Slot A (OR 1-1): Beer|Wine|Cocktail  +  Slot B (AND ≤2): Bread & Chicken') for slot-based combos so the empty 'WHEN TICKET CONTAINS' row isn't shown for new combos.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _combo_matches: correct — legacy path (no slots) + OR (total in [min,max]) + AND (each>=1 & each<=max). Matches spec.
Frontend Register.jsx totals combo logic mirrors backend (good).
ComboEditor migrates legacy flat product_ids into a single OR slot on edit — good backward-compat.
server.py: /api/combos POST/PATCH/DELETE have no role guard — any authenticated user can create/delete combos; consider restricting to admin/manager for consistency with staff routes.
server.py file is ~910 lines — approaching split threshold; combos endpoints could be extracted into routers/combos.py like tables/kegs were.
seed_data_creation: Fixture creates TEST_ITER12_* combos and cleans them up after each test. UI test left one 'TEST_UI_COMBO_ITER12' combo behind (cleanup step failed on 403 during curl-based delete; combo can be deleted manually from Menu > Combos).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 12 combo slot feature is functionally correct on both API and UI. Prior iterations 1-11 not re-run (per instructions). One residual UI polish item: combo card list view is missing slot rule chips for slot-based combos. Backend combo endpoints are unauthenticated beyond login — consider role gating.
rca of the issue: No blocking issues. Minor UI enhancement identified: Menu.jsx combo card rendering only reads legacy c.product_ids, so slot-based combos show a blank chip row. Fix: render slot summary chips when c.slots?.length > 0.
